sources.notes: The review question spans modality roles, fusion timing, representation alignment, post-training, and deployment-time sensor availability; these interfaces are wider than the static tactile-force and VLA families alone.

queries.label: dynamic-vision-language-tactile-action
queries.query: all:(vision AND language AND tactile AND action) AND all:robot
queries.why: Capture explicit extensions from VLA to vision-language-tactile-action policies.

queries.label: dynamic-force-conditioned-tactile-foresight
queries.query: all:(force AND tactile AND prediction) AND all:(robot AND manipulation)
queries.why: Find methods that separate global force signals from local tactile dynamics and use them predictively.

queries.label: dynamic-representation-aligned-tactile-grounding
queries.query: all:(tactile AND representation AND grounding) AND all:(robot AND action)
queries.why: Test whether tactile supervision is moving from raw-input fusion to selected action-representation layers.

queries.label: dynamic-tactile-distillation
queries.query: all:(tactile AND distillation) AND all:(robot OR manipulation)
queries.why: Cover training-time touch or force supervision that is distilled away at deployment.

queries.label: dynamic-contact-gated-multimodal-fusion
queries.query: all:(contact AND gated AND multimodal AND fusion) AND all:robot
queries.why: Capture sparse/event-driven fusion that activates physical modalities only around contact.

queries.label: dynamic-multisensory-continual-adaptation
queries.query: all:(multisensory AND continual AND learning) AND all:(robot AND force)
queries.why: Find post-training routes that adapt pretrained visual policies to force or touch without full retraining.

queries.label: dynamic-missing-modality-robustness
queries.query: all:(missing AND modality AND robustness) AND all:(robot AND manipulation)
queries.why: Cover sensor-dropout and deployment-time modality-mismatch counterevidence.

queries.label: dynamic-tactile-vla-post-training
queries.query: all:(tactile AND VLA AND post-training) AND all:robot
queries.why: Capture tactile self-correction and policy steering methods applied after VLA pretraining.

browser_fallback_queries.label: dynamic-vlta-browser
browser_fallback_queries.query: site:arxiv.org/abs (tactile OR force) (VLA OR vision-language-action) robot manipulation
browser_fallback_queries.why: Recover named VLTA/VLA tactile variants missed by metadata wording.

web_calibration_queries.label: dynamic-alignment-calibration
web_calibration_queries.query: site:arxiv.org/abs tactile representation alignment action expert robot
web_calibration_queries.why: Calibrate recent wording around where tactile supervision is injected.
